result:
Verified the fix. I've reordered the pipeline to follow Rule 2 of the release engineering skill: **cheap fast checks must gate before slow expensive ones**.

**What changed:**
- **Lint** now runs first (no dependencies) — catches style errors like missing semicolons in seconds
- **Unit tests** run after lint — fast feedback on code correctness
- **Staging deploy** runs after unit tests pass — only then builds and deploys
- **Integration tests** run after staging is live — ~22-minute E2E suite
- **Production deploy** runs after all tests pass

A missing semicolon now fails at the lint stage (seconds) instead of after 24 minutes of staging deploy + integration tests. All existing checks remain; only their order changed.
